Sanders Calls Out AI Industry Political Spending

"My message to the AI CEO’s: If you truly care about the future of humanity, stop pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into super PACs to defeat Members of Congress and candidates who are fighting for serious guardrails on AI," Sanders said.
In an accompanying video, Sanders argued that executives concerned about AI safety should respect voters’ ability to determine how the technology is regulated.

Trump Pushes Back On AI Slowdown
has taken a different position, arguing that the U.S. needs to maintain its lead over China in AI and that excessive regulation could weaken that advantage.
Trump has also dismissed concerns about AI systems becoming uncontrollable, calling fears about robots taking over "all a hoax."
Meanwhile, Chinese security officials have warned that AI could create risks involving misinformation, cyberattacks, espionage and military competition.
Musk Has Spent Millions Backing Trump
Musk spent nearly $250 million supporting Trump during the run-up to the 2024 presidential election, while also endorsing Trump at several public events.

In August, it was reported that Musk planned to spend between $100 million and $120 million to support at least eight Republican candidates in the upcoming midterm elections through his super PAC, America PAC.
